changes_made.explanation: Removed DE (dual encoder) as it's not an NLG model but a retriever. Added GPT-2-medium which is mentioned. Added 'standalone questions' as an output description to better capture the task.
All metrics were correctly extracted and normalized. These are standard retrieval metrics used to evaluate the quality of the generated queries.
No LLMs were used as evaluators in this paper. The paper uses retrieval metrics (MRR, Recall) for evaluation.
The paper does not conduct human evaluations. It relies exclusively on automatic retrieval metrics for evaluation.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on query rewriting for conversational question answering using reinforcement learning. The main NLG task is query rewriting/paraphrase generation to convert conversational questions into standalone questions. Evaluation is done through retrieval performance metrics (MRR, Recall) rather than traditional NLG metrics like BLEU/ROUGE. The extraction was generally accurate, with only minor adjustments needed.
